ideas.title: Minnesota Daycare Owner Accused of Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the case of a Minnesota daycare owner who was accused of billing the county for kids he never watched and pocketing $3000.
questions: How did the daycare owner manage to bill the county for kids he never watched?
What measures can be taken to prevent similar cases of fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This case highlights the need for increased oversight and monitoring of government programs to prevent fraud.

ideas.title: Federal Investigation into AppLovin
ideas.description: Investigate the ongoing federal investigation into AppLovin marketing platform.
questions: What are the implications of the investigation for AppLovin and related companies?
What measures can be taken to prevent similar cases of corporate fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This investigation could lead to significant developments in the tech industry and may impact related companies.
